name: Irith
source: A monster girl who mimics equipment such as armor and innerwear. She parasitizes in hope of a person, keep and breeds as her own livestock. She mimics the equipment that the target can easily pick up, and once parasitized,  she lives and dies with the host, so their also called "`husband and wife imitators ". She looks silent because she can communicate intuitively, but she is surprisingly annoyed.
